URL: https://www.ons.gov.uk/economy/governmentpublicsectorandtaxes/publicsectorfinance/bulletins/publicsectorfinances/july2026
(ONS public sector finances, July 2026 — carried from today's morning brief sources; cross-ref BBC)
Cross-ref URL: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cly8kzkyvwgo

UK July public borrowing (ONS, published 21 Aug 2026):
- The government borrowed £1.8bn in July — some £2.3bn more than the official (OBR) forecast
  and higher than a year earlier — underlining the squeeze facing the Chancellor before his
  first budget.
- Borrowing over the financial year so far has fallen on last year but remains above forecast;
  national debt is near 94% of GDP, just under £3 trillion.
- Chancellor John Healey said the government was "committed to meeting our fiscal rules".

North Sea oil & gas (Sky News, 21 Aug 2026):
URL: https://news.sky.com/story/oil-and-gas-industry-urges-pm-to-approve-controversial-north-sea-developments-13573878
- The oil and gas industry is pressing PM Andy Burnham to approve two contentious North Sea
  developments as a public consultation on them closes — an early test of the government's
  energy priorities. Supporters cite jobs and energy security; opponents say new drilling is
  incompatible with climate goals. The decision lands with the Gulf crisis keeping oil high.
